description: Lumen Harness baseline: five native video modes, two languages, and two boundary cases per mode.

cases.prompt: 一盏钨丝灯照亮空荡的老电影院，镜头极慢地向银幕推进，空气里有细小尘埃。
深夜雨巷里，一位穿深青色风衣的女人从远处走来，霓虹倒映在积水中，镜头平稳跟拍，保持连续的暖冷对比。
A tungsten lamp reveals an empty old cinema as the camera makes an almost imperceptible push toward the screen, dust floating in the beam.
On a rainy alley at night, a woman in a deep navy coat walks toward camera while neon reflections ripple in puddles; a steady tracking shot preserves the warm-cool contrast.
画面中的人物轻轻抬眼，窗外雨光在脸上移动，保持人物身份和服装不变。
画面中的人物沿着昏暗走廊向前行走，镜头从正面缓慢绕到侧面，保持脸部、发型、深色风衣和钨丝灯光一致。
The person in the frame slowly lifts their eyes as rain light moves across the face; preserve identity and wardrobe.
The person walks down a dim corridor while the camera slowly arcs from front to profile; keep the face, hairstyle, dark coat, and tungsten lighting consistent.
参考人物与色板，人物在暖琥珀色房间里转身看向镜头，保持服装质感与光线方向。
依据参考人物和色板，人物穿过有雾的旧车站大厅，镜头横向移动并在末尾停住；保持脸部、服装、琥珀色调和阴影方向一致。
Using the character and palette references, the person turns toward camera in a warm amber room; preserve wardrobe texture and light direction.

Following the character and palette references, the person crosses a foggy vintage station hall as the camera tracks sideways and settles at the end; preserve face, wardrobe, amber grade, and shadow direction.
保留原动作与构图，只把整体色调调整为克制的钨丝灯暖色，并加入轻微胶片颗粒。
保留人物身份、服装和镜头运动，在不改变构图的前提下加入细雨、暖色边缘光和轻微胶片颗粒。
Keep the action and composition, shift the grade to restrained tungsten warmth, and add subtle film grain.
Preserve the person's identity, wardrobe, and camera motion; add fine rain, a warm rim light, and subtle film grain without changing the composition.
从源片最后一刻自然延续，人物继续向前走两秒，保持末帧的光线、服装和运动方向。
从源片最后一刻连续延长十秒，人物走出车站并进入雨夜，保持角色、服装、色调和镜头速度不变。
Continue naturally from the final moment: the person keeps walking for two seconds, preserving the last frame's light, wardrobe, and motion direction.
Extend continuously for ten seconds from the final moment as the person leaves the station into the rain; keep character, wardrobe, grade, and camera speed unchanged.

harnessCases.subject: person
harnessCases.prompt: 深夜雨巷，一位穿深青色风衣、及肩黑色直发的女人从巷口走到便利店门前，停下抬头看招牌。三个镜头：远景跟拍、中景侧面、近景抬头；每次换镜都要能认出是同一个人。严格保持不变：同一位人物的脸、及肩黑色直发、深青色风衣与白色衬衫领；钨丝暖光从画面左侧来，冷蓝街光在右侧作为补光，胶片颗粒与 35mm 镜头语言不变。

harnessCases.subject: person
harnessCases.prompt: A rainy alley at night: a woman in a deep-teal trench coat with shoulder-length straight black hair walks from the alley mouth to a convenience-store door, stops, and looks up at the sign. Three shots: wide tracking, medium profile, close-up looking up; she must read as the same person across every cut. Keep unchanged throughout: the same person's face, shoulder-length straight black hair, deep-teal trench coat with a white shirt collar; warm tungsten key from frame left, cool blue street light as fill from the right, film grain and 35mm lens language.

harnessCases.subject: person
harnessCases.prompt: 画面中的人物从首帧的姿态开始，沿昏暗走廊走向尽头的窗，镜头从正面缓慢绕到侧面再回到正面；不要重新描述外貌，以首帧为唯一身份依据。严格保持不变：同一位人物的脸、及肩黑色直发、深青色风衣与白色衬衫领；钨丝暖光从画面左侧来，冷蓝街光在右侧作为补光，胶片颗粒与 35mm 镜头语言不变。

harnessCases.subject: person
harnessCases.prompt: Starting from the pose in the first frame, the person walks down a dim corridor toward the window at its end while the camera arcs slowly from front to profile and back; the first frame is the only identity reference, do not re-describe the face. Keep unchanged throughout: the same person's face, shoulder-length straight black hair, deep-teal trench coat with a white shirt collar; warm tungsten key from frame left, cool blue street light as fill from the right, film grain and 35mm lens language.

harnessCases.subject: scene
harnessCases.prompt: 清晨的山谷薄雾，镜头从山脊缓慢推进到谷底溪流，再切到雾中松林的中景，最后停在被晨光穿透的雾面。无人物。严格保持不变：同一座山谷的地形轮廓、雾的浓度层次、青灰色调与低角度暖金侧光；镜头速度均匀，不加任何人物。

harnessCases.subject: scene
harnessCases.prompt: Morning mist in a valley: the camera pushes slowly from the ridge down to the creek, cuts to a medium shot of pines inside the mist, and settles on the mist face pierced by first light. No people. Keep unchanged throughout: the same valley silhouette, the layering of the mist, the blue-grey grade with low-angle warm gold side light; even camera speed, no people introduced.

harnessCases.subject: person
harnessCases.prompt: 同一位穿深青色风衣的女人穿过雨夜的旧车站：进站大厅是一段约 25 秒的连续动作（跨镜用尾帧续接，观感不能像切镜），随后切到站台等车、列车驶来的车窗反射、最后她登车回头。四段里始终是同一个人。严格保持不变：同一位人物的脸、及肩黑色直发、深青色风衣与白色衬衫领；钨丝暖光从画面左侧来，冷蓝街光在右侧作为补光，胶片颗粒与 35mm 镜头语言不变。

harnessCases.subject: person
harnessCases.prompt: 画面中的人物离开首帧位置，穿过有雾的旧车站大厅、走上站台、在列车灯光中停下，最后回到与首帧相同的姿态和位置收尾。尾帧仅保存不硬锁，评分时记录结尾定格是否合理。严格保持不变：同一位人物的脸、及肩黑色直发、深青色风衣与白色衬衫领；钨丝暖光从画面左侧来，冷蓝街光在右侧作为补光，胶片颗粒与 35mm 镜头语言不变。

harnessProtocol.baselineNote: 同一 prompt 由三条独立 ≤15s 原生 T2V 直接 concat，不经 Director / 尾帧链 / QC；与 Harness 成片盲评对照。

operatorScenarios.qc_retry: 对 h30-t2v-zh-person 设 HARNESS_QC_VISUAL_THRESHOLD=0.99 跑一次，记录每镜 retries、needs_review 与账目。
operatorScenarios.interrupt_resume: 对 h45-t2v-en-scene 在 generating_shots 阶段停掉 next dev 再启动，记录续跑是否重跑 Director、重付已成功镜。

harnessProtocol.denominatorRule: 所有尝试进 evals/runs，失败样本不得从分母移除；定阈值样本与报告样本分开标注 purpose: calibration | report。
